turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Ms. Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen got a zero on his phone in the middle of your class, and nobody called me first.

Welcome. Quick housekeeping: I'm going to sum up your position in my own words, you correct me. 'Mrs. Kalinowski believes her son did nothing wrong and that the school acted improperly.' Is that a fair summary, and anything to add or fix?
Meredith: Ms. Hale, I'm not here to be summarized. Your summary leaves out the thing that matters: the zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me. Fix that first.
